collectible.title: (1) New Buddy Request(s)!
collectible.subtitle: Cadence wants to be your Buddy! Do you accept?
collectible.text:
You're now Buddies with Cadence!

This is a very special occurrence, as players can't send Buddy requests to mascots like Cadence – they have to send one to you. On top of the value that comes with this rarity in the Club Penguin world, having a mascot on your Buddy list gives you access to rare goodies such as unique autographed player backgrounds! This particular background doesn't look like it was ever available through regular Club Penguin gameplay, though…
